_comment: Uniform-FR campaign, Stage 4 (ethane in rigid all-silica LTA). Frozen BEFORE the two-arm production run. The reference (umbrella+WHAM F(z), conditional U(z), entropy decomposition) is built first and independently; the FR rate is chosen by SAFETY-ONLY calibration (genealogy/event criteria, never any error metric).
_provenance: docs/UNIFORM_FR_CAMPAIGN.md Stage 4. Do not edit after the production run starts.

system.framework: IZA DLS76-optimized all-silica LTA (cache/lta/LTA.cif), rigid, 2x2x2 pseudo-cells, a=11.919 A, box L=23.838 A, PBC; only framework O interacts
system.guest: TraPPE-UA ethane: 2 CH3 beads, harmonic bond r0=1.54 A k=400 kJ/mol/A^2
system.dynamics: overdamped Langevin q += dt*F + sqrt(2 dt/beta) eta, dt=2e-4 (alkanes/WCA convention); equilibrium quantities are dynamics-independent
system.cv: phi = wrap((2 pi/a) x_COM); window plane at phi=0, alpha-cage centers at +-pi; z = phi a/(2 pi)

reference.protocol: 40 umbrella windows on the circle, kappa=300 kJ/mol/rad^2, 256 replicas/window, 150k steps, 30k burn-in, sample every 25; histogram WHAM (180 bins); conditional U(z) from the same ensemble; unbiased 16384x300k cross-check
reference.entropic_claim_rule: the label 'entropic barrier' may be used only if -T dS >= 50% of dF at 300 K, measured from this artifact

fr_rate.rule: largest rate from the ladder {0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20} whose SHORT calibration run satisfies min ancestor ESS/N >= 0.30 AND max lineage share <= 0.05 (per-opportunity turnover is capped structurally by max_event_fraction=0.02; events/replica is reported, not gated); chosen WITHOUT reading e_F, I_F or tau; filled in by scripts/calibrate_lta_fr.py before production
fr_rate.frozen_at: 2026-08-29, by the safety-only rule, before production

seeds.note: unused anywhere else in the repo

endpoints: identical to the campaign-level rules in docs/UNIFORM_FR_CAMPAIGN.md: primary Delta I_F (trapezoid over saves, paired median, 10k bootstrap seed 20260829), final non-inferiority +5%, tau per atlas convention (persist 0.2 T), KL(p||uniform) mechanism series, genealogy floors as in the calibration rule
prohibited: tuning any FR knob on an error metric
temperature sweep before the 300 K verdict
editing this file after production starts
